inputs: explicit staff qualification and knowledge/skill references
positive dated training/staff/material claims in shared DOM-02 work
one canonical facility-slot account per asset/period with all competing claims
explicit eligibility, authority, target policy bindings and selected resolution rules
procedure: Validate links, distinct requirements, direct authority and disjoint account/claim pools. Resolve policies through WP-013. Evaluate shared work/goods with DOM-02 and independently allocate facility commitments with the shared allocator. Mark capacity-ready only when all prerequisites are fulfilled and qualification/access/policy are known. Preserve unknowns and unmet requirements. No delivered learning or atomic service is inferred.
independent_oracle: Five student hours face three employment, two learning and four care hours. Employment then learning leaves care unmet; care then learning leaves one learning hour unmet. Two teacher hours, two kg materials and one facility slot are separate prerequisites. A 108-input finite integer grid checks quantities and readiness; actual care and provisioning consumers retain identical budgets and postings.

No inferred qualification, learning or behavioral coefficient
